notes.title: Steam Cloud and MacOS Build Added
notes.content:
We're excited to announce an update for [i]Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters[/i]:
[list]
[*] MacOS build added to Steam.
[*] Steam Cloud enabled with automatic cloud saves.
[/list]

Please note that cloud saves are platform specific, with Windows/Deck save data separate from MacOS save data.

tags.feature: - Steam Cloud enabled with automatic cloud saves.
